question: Does the retrospective at-most-100-molecule matched subset reproduce the 66-cell full-grid IG and GradInput results closely enough to support subset-qualified five-method comparisons?
comparability_guard: Only historical full-grid and matched-subset outputs generated under index_tiebreak_v1 are compared; no tie-inclusive result enters this audit.
reference: all rationale-bearing molecules in each frozen calibration and test split
candidate: SHA-256-ordered subset capped at 100 rationale-bearing molecules per split
descriptive_checks: Pearson and Spearman correlation across cells
mean and median absolute error and signed bias
prespecified_support_rule: For both methods and both primary outcomes, Spearman rho must be at least 0.80 and mean absolute error at most 0.05; risk-pass and efficiency-pass agreement must each be at least 0.90. This supports only subset-qualified conclusions and does not promote the retrospective experiment to an untouched primary analysis.
negative_result_policy: All adverse, null, and family-specific findings are retained.
